title: Windows Installer Configuration
description: multimedica-installer.json — read by provision-scanner.ps1; never logged. Contains only the bootstrap QR authorization token. Cloud credentials (shared_secret, endpoint_url) arrive through the cloud_config QR during commissioning and are never held in this file.

qr_admin_token.description: Fleet-wide QR authorization token. Opaque exact value. Never log, normalize, trim, or case-fold.
